# Instructions for GitHub Copilot

Read [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) at the repository root before working here. It is the single
project guide for every coding agent, whichever tool you are: what this repo is, how to build and
test it, the branch and commit rules, and the writing style. Engineering lessons for this repo are
in [`.claude/skills/`](../.claude/skills/README.md).

Service blueprints are not built in this repo. They belong to
[Wayfinder](https://github.com/jonnymuir/Wayfinder) and
[Wayfinder.Umbraco](https://github.com/jonnymuir/Wayfinder.Umbraco).
